headline: 60-country AI-Digital ministerial meeting issues a nonbinding cooperation statement
summary: At a 19 October 2026 AI-Digital ministerial meeting in Seoul, the Republic of Korea Ministry of Science and ICT says representatives from about 60 countries joined the World Bank in discussing international cooperation. The attached chair statement identifies AI and digital inclusion and access, public service innovation, and an innovative AI and digital ecosystem as shared priorities, and calls for continued policy dialogue and experience sharing. The statement is high-level and nonbinding: it sets out no funding, delivery timeline, accountable implementation body, or enforceable commitments. It documents coordination intent, not changes in national policy or implementation.
